# BYLD · Buildd From Ideas

> BYLD gives hotels more than a franchise does, without franchise fees: a PMS, AI pricing approved by a human revenue manager, comp-set intelligence, owner reporting, OTA payout recovery, your own loyalty program, group sales and reputation.

BYLD is a hotel revenue operations partner. AI and machine-learning models recommend; a named human revenue manager approves every rate. It positions itself as offering more than a hotel franchise does, without franchise fees.

## Portfolio
- Hotels live: 32 (on the BYLD platform)
- Revenue managed: $40.6M (annually, across our hotels)
- Year-over-year growth: +62% (in revenue at the hotels we manage)
- Nights priced ahead: 57 (for every room category, every day)

## Products
- [BFIS™ PMS](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/bfis-pms): Cloud property management system with a live tape chart, room status and folios. Status: Live.
- [PriceCortex™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/pricecortex): AI rate recommendations for every room category, 57 nights ahead, approved by your revenue manager. Status: Live.
- [CompMatrix™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/compmatrix): Your rate against your whole comp set for the next 30 days, refreshed daily. Status: Live.
- [FolioLens™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/foliolens): Owner reporting: actual vs plan, last year and your market, with a weekly brief. Status: Live.
- [RevVitals™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/revvitals): A full revenue and OTA marketing health check, turned into a tracked action plan. Status: Live.
- [OTARecon365™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/otarecon365): Every OTA payout audited booking by booking, and missing money recovered. Status: Live.
- [GoldKey™ Rewards](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/goldkey-rewards): A loyalty program with your hotel's name on it that drives direct bookings. Status: Launching.
- [SalesLock™ Concierge](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/saleslock): Group and RFP leads captured, approved by phone and answered before the deadline. Status: Pilot · Jan 2027.
- [KeyCircle™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/keycircle): Thank the people who choose your hotel for their company, and keep them loyal. Status: Launching.
- [AskRank™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/askrank): Search, listing and AI-assistant visibility, run for you and reported in your portal. Status: Pilot starting.
- [PulsePilot™](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/pulsepilot): In-stay guest feedback by QR, GM alerts in real time, and more Google reviews. Status: Early access.
- [Website, Booking Engine & Photography](https://buildfromideas.ai/products/direct-booking): A fast hotel website, a booking engine connected to any PMS in about a week, and pro photos. Status: Service.
